location_exception_reason: RCC Labour Quarters are manufactured structures sold nationwide to construction and industrial sites across India; location of manufacture or seller headquarters does not change the product's function or buyer decision-making. Buyers select based on specifications (room size, concrete type, amenities), not origin geography.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'RCC Labour Quarter Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title. The product is the structure itself, not the business relationship.
